description: This file defines the interface 'HolidayWritePlatformService' which provides methods for creating, updating, activating, and deleting holiday records within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: HolidayWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining operations for managing holiday data in the system.

methods.name: createHoliday
methods.description: Creates a new holiday entry based on the provided command.

methods.name: updateHoliday
methods.description: Updates an existing holiday entry with new data.

methods.name: activateHoliday
methods.description: Activates a holiday identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteHoliday
methods.description: Deletes the holiday identified by its ID.
